_about: Machine-readable vocabulary of every AdvancedMD / Stedi API call the project has captured. ONE entry per call. docs/postman_effinger_amd.json is GENERATED from this file by tools/mirror/postman_build.py — edit here, never the collection. Never store a token, password, key, patient name or member number in this file.

variables.token: AMD usercontext token from login (never stored)

calls.name: updateinsurance — change one plan field (wrapped shape)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="updateinsurance" class="demographics" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" ><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><patient id="pat{{patientid}}" changed="1"><insplanlist><insplan id="ins{{insid}}" enddate="{{new}}" o_enddate="{{old}}"/></insplanlist></patient></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: Send ONLY the changed field plus its o_<field> original; echoing every attribute fails 'Another user has changed this insurance record'. The bare unwrapped <insplan/> child can fault 'Value can not be null' (9/8). The `sequence` attribute is NOT the plan's number here - AMD reads it as the PATIENT's insurance ORDER (insorder): sequence="2,1" sets Medicare-first; echoing a plan's own sequence on any other edit resets the patient order to that one plan (9/14/2026, pat17472393: a begin-date edit turned insorder 4,3 into 4). ins_update.update() drops it unless passed. PATIENT ORDER (10/6/2026, chart 12232248): sequence="2,1" sent through a plan that is END-DATED answers success="1" with <patient insorder=""/> - the order is wiped; the same call through an ACTIVE plan lands; an order cannot lead with an end-dated plan. ins_update.update sends the order as its own call through an active plan named in the order (leading plan first), verifies it, re-sends once, puts back an order that a field edit wiped, refuses an end-dated lead without writing, and never raises after a write.
calls.helper: ins_update.update(pid, insid, **fields) - sequence= goes through an active plan, verified (10/6/2026)

calls.name: updvisitwithcharges — FULL-ECHO resave (void trap!)
calls.body: <ppmdmsg action="updvisitwithcharges" class="chargeentry" msgtime="{{msgtime}}" ><usercontext>{{token}}</usercontext><visit id="vst{{visitid}}" patient="pat{{patientid}}" insorder="{{insorder}}" refplan="{{refplan}}" preauth="{{preauth}}" facility="fac{{facilityid}}" force="1" approval="1" inspectorenabled="1" batchid=""><chargelist><charge id="charge{{chargeid}}" ...EVERY ACTIVE CHARGE OF THE VISIT, ALL ATTRIBUTES ECHOED... modcodes="mcode7"><diagcodelist><diagcode id="{{numeric dcode id}}"/></diagcodelist></charge></chargelist></visit></ppmdmsg>
calls.description: REPLACES the visit's charge list with what you send — any charge omitted is VOIDED (30 charges lost 9/2–9/3). Build from resave.visit_charges(chargeid); never echo a single-charge detail on a multi-charge visit. diagcodes= attr is silently IGNORED for edits — dx saves only via the nested <diagcodelist> child with NUMERIC ids (9/8). modcodes = mcode ids (25 = mcode7). insorder = comma list of plan SEQUENCE numbers. refplan/preauth repoint the visit to a referral plan and write the auth onto it (and onto the previous plan — process the stay keeping the original plan LAST).
calls.helper: resave.py, recode._save(cid, fn), move_to_ins.move(cid, seq), amdw.resave_visit

calls.name: Upload an 835 into the ERA Center (POST /api/era/upload/835, multipart)
calls.body: multipart/form-data: field 'file' = <name>.835 (Content-Type text/plain, the raw X12 835 text)
calls.description: Captured from William's UI import 9/2/2026 (era_upload.py); proven 9/22/2026 with SYNTHETIC 835s built from paper EOBs (billing/paper_remits/build835.py). Response {issuccess, filename, filesize, filemd5checksum}; the check appears in GET /api/era/checks asynchronously (5 s to ~4 min; polling every 5 s drew HTTP 500s, poll every 10 s). Dedupe is by file MD5, not by TRN: the same bytes are skipped, a different file with the same TRN creates a NEW check. AMD matches CLP01 = the AMD claim number (8-digit visit id + sequence letter, e.g. 19442529A) to the visit and each SVC line to the charge by CPT; it reads ONE reason per CAS segment (a second triplet in the same CAS is dropped -> 'Contains invalid payment reason codes'); AMT*B6 is ignored (allowed = charge - adjustments); a claim with no SVC lines still matches the visit and shows chargecount / chargecode / insurancebalance but errors 'Procedure codes do not match' (chargedetailid -1) - usable as a probe; the check's systemcarrier is whatever AMD matched from N1*PR (often the visit's BILLED carrier), so a paper payer is posted with the ERA-linked addpayments carrying carrierid = the payer's plan on the chart.

A $0 payment without reason codes blocks the next-payer claim ('Payment reason codes are missing or do not balance') - fix = void it (void class=void) and release. | 9/21/2026: retired for ERA lines - use the ERA-linked shape (payments-era/addpayments-era-linked-manual-post-with-reason-codes), which keeps the CARCs.

Post the payment line of an unvalidated ERA, never the $0 denial line (9/6 error, fixed 9/7). | SWEEP RULE (9/21/2026): posting a single visit of a check (FORCE_VISITS) made AMD's engine post 29 OTHER claims of the same check, each capped at the visit's open balance (the leftover PR2), on visits that still carried hand posts, then mark the check processed + dismissed. Never Post a single visit of a check while other claims of that check sit on hand-posted / partially-open visits - void those first or post single lines with payreasons.post_line; after any Post run payreasons.py --audit --since-payid <last id before the post> and void + re-post anything capped.

HOW THE RUNS PICK (William 9/7, 9/11, 9/12):

 WOLATE     payer denied untimely (CO29/PI29), no proof of timely filing
 WONCS      non-covered service (CO96/PR96; CCM billed Medicaid-primary)
 WOCAID2ND  dual: Medicaid secondary residual after Medicare/MA paid (crossover $0)
 WOMCAD     residual on a Medicaid-PRIMARY charge
 WOSMBAL    small balance under $25 per patient
 WOBAD      patient no-pay / bad debt after one statement cycle; WOFIN financial difficulty; WORTNADD statement returned, no address
 WOAPPEAL   after an appeal is denied; WOAREXH every payer and the patient exhausted
 WOINSBANK  parking write-off later voided when the balance goes back to insurance
 WOCLTREQ   a write-off William directs in chat / on the board with no better-fitting code ('client request'); prefer the more descriptive code when one fits (William 9/12)
 WOCOUR     courtesy - NEVER across the board on Medicare/MA cost-sharing
 WOMISC / WOINCL / WOGLOB / WOFILE / WOINFO / WOPDEOB / WOPD90+AR / WOPD90+PB / WOENDCOLLA / WOSTATE / WOBANK / ADJCAP / ADJRISK / #WORU / PROMPT: in the master file, not yet used by a run - ask before using. -->

1. gettxhistory patientid=pat{{patientid}} -> the visit's live payments with NO payreason children (amounts negative; charge insbal/patbal/fee).
2. void class=void: the code-less payment, the WOINS posted with it (same createtime) and any $0 code-less line.
3. The ERA claim behind it: registers/era_manual_register.json (checkid/checkclaimid/chargeid), else the payment's check number against GET /api/era/checks and GET /api/era/checks/dismiss?DismissedDateBegin=YYYY-MM-DD. Dismissed check: POST /api/era/checks/reversedismiss [{"id","dismissedat"}] -> GET /api/era/checkdetails?checkid= (claims come back with carc ids) -> POST /api/era/checks/dismiss again. Processed check answers nothing: use era_details/<checkid>.json.
4. Re-post the same line with the ERA-linked addpayments (payments-era/addpayments-era-linked-manual-post-with-reason-codes).
5. Verify |paid| + sum(reason amounts) == fee on every live payment, then hideunbillablevisits hide="-1" with the NUMERIC visit id.
-->

calls.name: RECIPE — paper / virtual-card EOB -> synthetic 835 -> ERA Center -> ERA-linked post under the payer's carrier
calls.body:
<!-- billing/paper_remits/post_paper.py, per (payer family, check/card reference):
1. build835.build(group) -> POST /api/era/upload/835 (payments-era/upload-835) -> poll GET /api/era/checks for TRN02 -> GET /api/era/checkdetails?checkid=
2. per visit: getdemographic -> the payer's carrier on the chart (addinsurance without group number when missing, member id from the EOB) ; gettxhistory -> live charges (insbalance, live payments, write-offs)
3. line decision: SKIP when a live payment already carries this check number; HOLD when another payer already paid the same amount and the balance is 0 (overpayment); void ONLY a write-off whose amount equals what the payer paid / the shortfall (a premature write-off), never the primary's contractual; pay = min(EOB paid, insurance balance); write-off in the SAME post: Medicaid plans (SIM01/FLO99) residual = WOCAID2ND when OA-23 is present else WOMCAD, Medigap residual = WOINS only when it equals the primary's CO45+253 never adjusted, otherwise nothing (AMD moves a Plan-N-style residual to the patient itself)
4. addpayments class=paymententry postingmethod="era" eraclaimid=checkclaimid erareportid=checkid carrierid=car<payer plan> checknumber=<clean check number> paymethod=11 (CHK) with the reasonlist from checkdetails (payments-era/addpayments-era-linked-manual-post-with-reason-codes) -> gettxhistory verifies the payment + reasons -> POST /api/era/checks/dismiss
5. a claim whose EOB has no CPT lines (or whose CPT differs from the chart): second file TRN <ref>L with AMD's own charge codes, paid allocated by fee, OA-23 for the remainder when another payer already paid the line -->

Incidents that shaped the rules: voiding every write-off on a line removed the Medicare contractual (re-applied: move_to_ins.move then manual_post WOINS); a Medigap AND a Medicaid plan both paying the same coinsurance is an overpayment HOLD, not a post.

calls.description: Variant of the ERA-linked manual post (proven 9/30/2026 on 25 Sunshine dual-crossover lines, check 1052885): the charge's <writeofflist> takes several <writeoff> children - WOINS = Medicare's contractual never adjusted (fee - Medicare paid - coinsurance; allowed = Medicare paid / 0.784, coinsurance 20% of allowed, 0 on G0439) and WOCAID2ND = the coinsurance the Medicaid secondary answered $0 on (OA-23 / CO-96 N448); payment amount 0, patient woamount = the sum, reasons from checkdetails. calls.name: ScanSnap batch -> container: the size ladder (Gmail RAW <=1 MB, Drive connector <=10 MB, Zapier byte-range slices above) - data route, no single HTTP call
calls.body:
<!-- 10/5/2026 measurements (Claude cloud session, 11 batches / 106 MB):
1. Gmail connector get_message RAW works to ~1 MB of PDF (MIME JSON persisted to a tool-results file) -> billing/era_input/fetch_scans.py gmail-raw. 5-7 MB attachments close the Gmail MCP connection.
2. Zapier Gmail 'Get Attachment by Filename' (message_id, attachment_filename) -> hydrate URL -> Zapier Google Drive 'Upload File' (file=<hydrate URL>, folder=1Fz90JGLa-s_QTw0RSuUdGnvQznxyGEHO 'eras scanned', convert=false, no new_name) -> Google Drive connector download_file_content (hard limit 10 MB) -> fetch_scans.py drive.
3. > 10 MB: Zapier code action google_drive_get_file_byte_range_base64 (file_id, start, length<=4000000) per 4 MB slice (5.3 MB JSON each, persisted) -> fetch_scans.py chunks (joins, checks Drive's md5).
Blocked: container proxy CONNECT 403 to zapier.com and drive.google.com; Zapier's code sandbox cannot resolve zapier.com (upload_urls_to_folder fails on hydrate URLs). One Zapier task per call: ~45 tasks for the 10/5 pile; the account's monthly limit ran out one slice short (William upgraded the plan the same night). Register: practices/ehpa/registers/scan_batches.json (Gmail message id, md5, pages, route). -->

calls.name: Zapier: Gmail attachment -> hydrate URL -> Google Drive 'Upload File' (native hydration, any size)
calls.body: {"step1": {"tool": "execute_zapier_read_action", "selected_api": "GoogleMailV2CLIAPI", "action": "attachment", "params": {"message_id": "{{gmail_message_id}}", "attachment_filename": "{{filename}}"}}, "step2": {"tool": "execute_zapier_write_action", "selected_api": "GoogleDriveCLIAPI", "action": "file", "params": {"file": "<results[0].attachment hydrate URL from step 1>", "folder": "1Fz90JGLa-s_QTw0RSuUdGnvQznxyGEHO", "convert": "false"}}}

Pass NO new_name (Zapier appends the extension again -> 'x.pdf.pdf'); a 'File Lookup Error' means the hydrate URL aged out - fetch a fresh one with step 1 and retry. Reply carries the Drive file id, fileSize and md5Checksum (verify the local copy against it).

calls.body: {"file_id": "{{drive_file_id}}", "start": "{{byte_offset}}", "length": "4000000"}  -> results.data.data {name, size, md5Checksum, start, length_returned, chunk_sha256, eof, data(base64)}

A 6 MB slice was never tested (the Drive connector choked at 9.6 MB of JSON, so stay at 4 MB). Each call is one Zapier task.
